Subject: Private VPC architecture review — next steps

Hi Samuel / Olivia,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap from our discovery call and a proposed next step to get into architecture specifics for your Private/VPC deployment: 

Summary of needs we heard
- Dedicated VPC with customer-managed routing and HSM/KMS integration
- Data separation and audit logging for regulated workloads (retention policy: 7 years)
- Expected steady-state throughput: ~2M tokens/day, spiky bursts for peak times
- Strict egress controls and SOC2 evidence requirements

Next step: technical architecture review (30–45 min) to align on network topology, firewall rules, KMS integration, and rollout plan. We’ll bring an engineer + solutions architect to walk through specifics.

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Thu 2027-03-18, 10:00–10:45
- Thu 2027-03-18, 14:00–14:45
- Fri 2027-03-19, 09:00–09:45

Please confirm which slot works best and any additional attendees from your side (security, infra, procurement). I’ve attached a quick network diagram template to help prep (FinTechCo_network_diagram.pdf).

Thanks,
